$comment: fmt and spdlog are intentionally NOT vcpkg-managed. They are sourced from conda alongside PDAL because conda's PDAL transitively pulls in fmt via its dependency tree (e.g. /opt/miniconda/include/fmt/). Mixing a vcpkg fmt with conda's fmt on the same include path causes ABI mismatches (vcpkg fmt 11 headers vs conda fmt 12 headers leak through PDAL's include dirs and produce undefined symbols at link time). The workflows in .github/workflows/build-{linux,windows}.yml add the conda prefix to CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH so find_package(fmt) resolves to conda's copy; on Windows they also explicitly conda-install fmt and spdlog because the conda PDAL Windows package does not pull them in.
